# TechNurture — Full Reference

> TechNurture Pvt Ltd is a home-appliance service company in Sri Lanka, providing fast, reliable repair, servicing and maintenance for air conditioners, refrigerators and washing machines. Genuine parts, trained technicians and island-wide coverage. A subsidiary of Lusako Holdings Pvt Ltd. Tagline: "Technology Inspired by Nurture".

TechNurture repairs and maintains home and commercial appliances of all major brands — regardless of who supplied or installed the unit. Every job starts with an honest on-site diagnosis and a transparent quotation before any work begins. Service is available island-wide across all nine provinces of Sri Lanka.

## Air Conditioning — https://technurture.lk/services/air-conditioning

AC repair, servicing, gas charging and installation for split, inverter and commercial air conditioning.

- Repairs & diagnostics: weak cooling, water leaks, strange sounds, blocked condensers, faulty components.
- Servicing & maintenance: cleaning, filter care and performance tuning every 3–6 months.
- Gas charging: refrigerant top-up and leak checks to restore cooling capacity.
- Installation: professional setup of split, inverter and commercial systems.
- Emergency repair support for residential and commercial environments.

## Refrigerator & Freezer — https://technurture.lk/services/refrigerator

Repair of cooling faults, gas refilling, compressor, thermostat and door-seal issues for fridges and freezers of every brand.

- Cooling & gas repair: leak detection, gas refilling, restoring correct cooling.
- Compressor & PCB: diagnosis and replacement of compressors, relays, thermostats and control boards.
- Seals & water leaks: door-gasket replacement, drainage and defrost fixes.
- Commercial refrigeration: display chillers, chest freezers and cold-room support.

## Washing Machine — https://technurture.lk/services/washing-machine

Repair of drainage, spin, drum, motor, PCB and water-inlet faults on front-load, top-load and fully-automatic washing machines.

- Drain & spin repair: machines that won't drain, spin or complete a cycle.
- Motor, belt & drum: bearing, belt, drum and motor repair for noise and vibration.
- Electronics & PCB: error-code diagnosis, control-board and sensor replacement.
- Inlet & leaks: water-inlet valve, hose and seal repairs.

## Maintenance & AMC — https://technurture.lk/services/maintenance-amc

Scheduled preventive maintenance and Annual Maintenance Contracts for air conditioners, refrigerators and washing machines.

- Comprehensive AMC: scheduled maintenance, labour, eligible spare-part replacement and priority support for one predictable annual cost.
- Non-Comprehensive AMC: professional servicing, inspections, labour and technical support, with parts charged separately.
- On-Call Service: service visits, breakdown troubleshooting and inspections on request — no contract required.
- Priority support: faster response times and planned preventive visits.

## Frequently asked questions

- How often should home appliances be serviced? Air conditioners every 3–6 months, refrigerators once a year, and washing machines whenever performance drops.
- Which appliance brands do you repair? All major brands of air conditioners, refrigerators, freezers and washing machines.
- Can you service equipment installed by another company? Yes — regardless of the original installer.
- Do you provide island-wide service coverage? Yes, across Sri Lanka.
- Maintenance contract options? Comprehensive AMC, Non-Comprehensive AMC, and On-Call Service.
- Do you provide emergency repair services? Yes, with fast response to urgent requests.
- How can I request a quotation? By phone, WhatsApp or the website inquiry form at https://technurture.lk/contact.
